contextReview.basis: Direct review: overcast daytime residential East Asian city lane with tiled shopfronts, a convenience store, potted plants, utility poles and overhead wires; dry asphalt, no rain depicted; humidity not inferred.

approval.evidence: Five editorials passed producer QA and continued under the user's standing workflow authorization (2026-11-03, "앞으로도 승인 없이 진행"); the user did not visually approve them individually. Product images passed producer technical QA and producer visual QA on four backgrounds only.

reconstructionNotice: The brown paper shopping bag held in both hands is a scene prop, not a product; the part of the bomber, tee and crossbody it covers is conservatively reconstructed. Hidden backs and soles are inferred. Brand, fibre composition, performance and retail identity are unknown.

producerVisualReview.findings: All 27 isolated products have complete silhouettes, matching garment colors and visible details, clean alpha edges across four backgrounds, matching footwear/sock pairs, gold hoop pair and complete watch. No props or forced running trim. Look05 jeans retain visible rear construction; hidden garment fronts are conservative reconstructions. No visible matte, checkerboard or external shadow.

copy.titleEn: A BLUE PAUSE IN THE LANE

title.en: A blue pause in the lane
title.de: Eine blaue Pause in der Gasse

deck.ko: 봉투를 고쳐 드는 짧은 순간의 선명한 봄버.
deck.en: A vivid bomber during a small shopping-bag adjustment.
deck.de: Eine kräftige Bomberjacke beim kurzen Umgreifen der Einkaufstüte.

intro.ko: 흐린 낮, 코발트 재킷이 회색 타일 앞에서 먼저 눈에 들어옵니다.
intro.en: On an overcast afternoon, cobalt stands out against gray shop tiles.
intro.de: Am bewölkten Nachmittag hebt sich Kobaltblau vor grauen Ladenfliesen ab.

body.ko: 짧고 둥근 봄버 아래 넓은 차콜 진을 이어 상하의 부피를 나눴습니다. 흰 티와 스니커의 고무 토가 어두운 하체를 가볍게 끊고, 작은 검정 크로스백은 두 손을 쓰는 동작에 맞춰 옆으로 놓입니다. 직광 플래시가 파란 소매의 주름을 또렷하게 잡습니다.
body.en: The short rounded bomber balances the broad charcoal jeans below. A white tee and rubber toe caps interrupt the darker lower half, while a small black crossbody rests to the side of the two-handed gesture. Direct flash makes the blue sleeve folds crisp.
body.de: Die kurze runde Bomberjacke gleicht die weite anthrazitfarbene Jeans aus. Weißes Shirt und Gummikappen unterbrechen die dunkle untere Hälfte. Eine kleine schwarze Umhängetasche liegt seitlich neben der Bewegung beider Hände. Direkter Blitz zeichnet die Falten der blauen Ärmel klar.

pull.en: Wide denim, a short blue center.
pull.de: Weite Jeans, eine kurze blaue Mitte.

copy.pullQuoteEn: Wide denim, a short blue center.

tip.ko: 가방을 골반 옆으로 옮겨 봄버 앞면과 손동작이 가려지지 않게 하세요.
tip.en: Move the bag beside the hip so it leaves the jacket front and hands visible.
tip.de: Die Tasche seitlich an die Hüfte schieben, damit Jackenfront und Hände sichtbar bleiben.

description.ko: 짧은 리브 칼라와 지퍼, 볼륨 소매, 리브 밑단의 파란 재킷.
description.en: Blue zip jacket with a short rib collar, full sleeves and ribbed hem.
description.de: Blaue Zipjacke mit kurzem Rippkragen, weiten Ärmeln und Rippbund.

howToWear.ko: 흰 티를 목선에 남기고 지퍼를 열어 파란색 면적을 조절하세요.
howToWear.en: Leave white at the neckline and adjust the blue area with the zip.
howToWear.de: Weiß am Ausschnitt lassen und die blaue Fläche mit dem Zip dosieren.
